summary: Warmth and coverage in one swipe. Engineered for medium-deep complexions, this deep ochre concealer camouflages blemishes with an undetectable velvet finish.
technical_overview: Offered at $24.0 for 6ml, this KoColor Fashion CONCEALER is expertly formulated with Water, Isononyl Isononanoate, Iron Oxides. Delivering a high-fidelity Deep Ochre (Warm-Medium) color profile (`#C59E76`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
